title:	#31-P2 Opt-in OpenTelemetry tracing + local Phoenix profile (queued)
state:	OPEN
author:	chux0519
labels:	
comments:	1
assignees:	
projects:	
milestone:	
number:	35
--
> **SDK decision (2026-11-24): Pydantic AI Slim.** Prefer Pydantic AI's native OpenTelemetry export; no OpenAI Agents SDK trace-processor adapter is required. Do not enable external trace export by default. Coordinate with #49 and #48.

> **Execution order: 3/4 — P1 observability.** **Depends on #49 (selected SDK + trace processor hook) and #48 (stable Stop/run lifecycle).** Use Pydantic AI's native OpenTelemetry Agent/LLM/Tool spans, adding only missing domain spans. The earlier custom-httpx/SDK-trace-processor wording is historical: with Pydantic AI, prefer native OTel instrumentation, supplement only missing spans, and avoid duplicates. Owns OTLP exporter, opt-in Phoenix Compose profile, redaction and end-to-end trace verification. Blocks integrated trace links in #47.

Parent: #31 (read it in full; baseline and non-goals there) · Rules: AGENTS.md · Design: docs/design/design.md §4
Queued after P0/P1. Scope exactly as #31 P2: OTEL_TRACING_ENABLED (default off), OTLP/HTTP exporter, nested spans agent.turn / agent.llm / agent.tool / airline.quote_route / core.routing / reply_guard / airline.book, one correlation id per turn, no PII/keys/nonces/prompts exported by default, exporter failure never affects chat or booking, optional Phoenix compose profile (not started by default) + README. New dependencies (opentelemetry-sdk, exporter) to be listed in the PR.
**Model:** Opus 5.5 · **Branch:** it06-otel
## P2 — Lightweight OpenTelemetry instrumentation (opt-in; no Phoenix dependency at runtime)

- [ ] Add **optional, disabled-by-default** OpenTelemetry tracing with a clear `OTEL_TRACING_ENABLED` switch and OTLP/HTTP exporter endpoint configuration. No exporter/collector outage may break booking or chat.
- [ ] Instrument nested spans: `agent.turn`, `agent.llm` (each attempt, status/tokens/latency), `agent.tool` (tool name, result code, duration), `airline.quote_route`, `core.routing` (algorithm, network fingerprint, path length), `reply_guard` (pass/fallback category), `airline.book` (status only).
- [ ] Carry one trace/correlation id across a conversation turn, the SSE request, LLM calls and tool records where practical. Ensure no raw API keys, confirmation nonces, auth cookies, user PII, or full prompts/tool outputs are exported by default. Redact or opt in explicitly for sensitive payloads. Use low-cardinality attributes for metrics.
- [ ] Add an **optional local-only Phoenix** profile/example to `docker-compose.yml` (or a separate Compose file) plus a short README explaining the flow and how to open the Phoenix UI at `http://localhost:6006`. The normal `docker compose up` must not start Phoenix.
- [ ] Maintain compatibility with the existing `httpx`-based LLM client and custom loop; do not rely on automatic OpenAI-SDK instrumentation to capture custom operations.

## Acceptance criteria

1. `uv run pytest -q` passes (and the existing full real-DB cross-check is unchanged).
2. For a fake completion containing >4 tool calls or a turn crossing 12 total tool calls, tests prove the excess calls **are not executed** and the response/context remains well-formed.
3. A turn crossing the token budget ends safely before initiating another LLM step; missing usage is accounted for conservatively or explicitly documented.
4. 90-second turn timeout, retries, and existing quote confirmation / nonce / idempotency guarantees remain intact.
5. The two eval regressions have named tests; the real-model evaluation report includes before/after observations.
6. Tracing is fully optional; when enabled, a single quoted itinerary creates a parent trace with visible child spans in a local Phoenix instance, and exporter failure does not alter booking outcomes.
7. Update `DESIGN.md` and `docs/design/design.md` as needed, documenting budget semantics and observability failure modes; include raw coding-agent sessions in `prompt history/` per take-home instructions.

## Non-goals

No MCP migration, Neo4j, Promptfoo framework adoption, new payment/seat model, or general refactor of the routing algorithm. Make small, reviewable changes; ideally separate P0, P1, and P2 into focused commits/PRs.
# Roadmap

Owner decisions and the order of work after the take-home MVP (07-ui, released 2026-11-24). Details live in the issues
and in each iteration's plan under `docs/iterations/`.

## Decision: move the generic agent loop to an agent SDK (2026-11-24)
The MVP runs a hand-written agent loop (`backend/app/agent/loop.py`, `llm.py`). The owner decided to move the generic
part of it to a mainstream agent SDK, for two reasons:
1. **Cancelling streamed output.** A user's Stop must cancel the backend run and close the upstream model stream, not
   just the browser's SSE reader. Native run cancellation in an SDK is preferred over a second hand-written
   cancellation layer.
2. **Systematic tracing.** Agent / LLM / tool spans from the SDK, exported through OpenTelemetry to a local Phoenix,
   instead of instrumenting a custom loop by hand.

Decided: **Pydantic AI Slim** (owner, 2026-11-24, after both POCs; evidence and boundaries in
`docs/design/adr-001-agent-runtime.md`). The SDK never gets booking authority: booking stays the user's click on a
confirm card (nonce, B1–B7), ReplyGuard still checks text before it is streamed, and app.db history, budgets and
concurrency limits stay our own code.

## Order
| # | Issue | Iteration | Depends on | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | #49 SDK POC, ADR, runtime migration | 08-runtime | — | done 2026-11-24 (ADR-001 Pydantic AI Slim, PR #53, released `963c9be`) |
| 2 | #48 backend run cancellation + Stop UI | 09-stop | #49 accepted | done 2026-11-24 (PR #54, released `43a72de`) |
| 3 | #35 OpenTelemetry + local Phoenix | 10-otel | #49, #48 accepted | next |
| 4 | #47 multi-model benchmark, optional Promptfoo (deepseek-flash official vs deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 and qwen3.8-flash on Bailian; tokens when price unknown) | 11-bench | #49, #48 (traces from #35) | queued |
| — | #41 SQLite limits + benchmark, PostgreSQL criteria | 08-runtime (parallel) | — | done (PR #51, docs/design/sqlite-concurrency.md) |
| — | #11 / #12 thinking level, BYOK, thinking bench | bonus | — | not scheduled |

Each item starts only after the one before it is accepted.

# ADR-001: Agent runtime — adopt Pydantic AI Slim

- Status: **accepted** (2026-11-24, decided by the owner after both POCs)
- Issue: #49 · Roadmap: [docs/roadmap.md](../roadmap.md) · Evidence:
  [poc-pydantic-ai.md](../iterations/08-runtime/poc-pydantic-ai.md),
  [poc-openai-agents.md](../iterations/08-runtime/poc-openai-agents.md), code in `spikes/`

## Context
The MVP runs a hand-written agent loop (`backend/app/agent/loop.py` + `llm.py`, an httpx client for the
OpenAI-compatible streaming protocol). Two next steps motivated a move to an agent SDK (owner, 2026-11-24):
a user **Stop** that cancels the backend run and the upstream model stream (#48), and **systematic tracing** through
OpenTelemetry to a local Phoenix (#35). Two candidates were tested on the real DeepSeek endpoint plus a fake
OpenAI-compatible server that records TCP close, with the same 15 checks.

## Evidence
| | Own loop (today) | Pydantic AI Slim 2.71 | OpenAI Agents SDK 0.25 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Streaming, sequential + parallel tool calls on DeepSeek | yes | yes (set sequential tools, `strict` off) | yes |
| Cancel → upstream TCP closed (median) | 0.1 ms (`aclose`) | 1.6–1.8 ms fake server, 0.6 ms DeepSeek | 0.4 ms |
| New LLM requests / tools after cancel | 0 (no Stop path yet) | 0 | 0 |
| Waits for started sync work on cancel | our `Threads.drain` | no, keep `Threads` | no, keep `Threads` |
| ReplyGuard before text is streamed | yes | yes (`iter` + `node.stream`) | yes |
| Budgets (steps, tools per step / turn, token soft cap) | ours | timeout and per-call output built in; rest via our `budget.py` | steps and timeout built in; rest via hooks |
| Tracing | none | OpenTelemetry native; **no outbound export by default** | own span model; **remote export to OpenAI on by default**, must be replaced |
| Runtime deps (packages) | 22–23 | +16 | +23 |
| Install / image delta | — | +39 MB unpacked, +7 MB compressed | about +56 MB |
| Cold import | 0.10–0.17 s | +0.32 s | +0.45 s |
| `backend/app/agent` net LOC | 2237 | about −120 (−5%) | about −100 (−5%) |
| Real-model cost of the POC | — | about $0.03 | $0.0046 |

First-token latency was within noise for all three.

## Decision
Adopt **Pydantic AI Slim** (`pydantic-ai-slim`, pinned) for the generic runtime: the model client (HTTP stream,
chunk parsing, tool-call assembly, provider request fields), tool dispatch and run cancellation. Its tracing is OpenTelemetry from the start, with no outbound export unless we configure an exporter.
That fits #35 directly. The dependency cost is the smaller of the two SDKs.

Neither SDK met the plan's "clearly less code to maintain" rule: each removes about 5% net. The owner chose
adoption anyway, for standard cancellation and tracing semantics that a widely used runtime maintains. Without the
SDK, the same features would be hand-written and maintained here. The recommended alternative, keeping the own loop,
was considered and rejected on these grounds.

## Boundaries — what stays our code
- **Booking:** no `book` tool. Tickets only from the user's click on a presented confirm card with a one-time nonce
  (`airline/`, B1–B7). `request_booking` only shows the card.
- **ReplyGuard** runs on buffered sentences before any text reaches the client; the SDK's output validators are not
  a substitute.
- **Tools:** `Tool.from_schema` over our `TOOL_SCHEMAS`; validation, structured errors and `Outcome` stay in
  `tools.py`. `user_id` / `conversation_id` come from trusted run deps, never from model arguments. Tools run
  **sequentially** and in call order, and their sync work goes through our `Threads` (drained before locks are
  released, C2).
- **History:** app.db history and compaction (`context.py`), converted to `message_history`. No SDK session store.
- **SSE contract** (`status`, `card`, `delta`, `replace`, `done`, `error`) is unchanged; SDK events are mapped to it.

# ADR-001: Agent runtime — adopt Pydantic AI Slim

- Status: **accepted** (2026-11-24, decided by the owner after both POCs)
- Issue: #49 · Roadmap: [docs/roadmap.md](../roadmap.md) · Evidence:
  [poc-pydantic-ai.md](../iterations/08-runtime/poc-pydantic-ai.md),
  [poc-openai-agents.md](../iterations/08-runtime/poc-openai-agents.md), code in `spikes/`

## Context
The MVP runs a hand-written agent loop (`backend/app/agent/loop.py` + `llm.py`, an httpx client for the
OpenAI-compatible streaming protocol). Two next steps motivated a move to an agent SDK (owner, 2026-11-24):
a user **Stop** that cancels the backend run and the upstream model stream (#48), and **systematic tracing** through
OpenTelemetry to a local Phoenix (#35). Two candidates were tested on the real DeepSeek endpoint plus a fake
OpenAI-compatible server that records TCP close, with the same 15 checks.

## Evidence
| | Own loop (today) | Pydantic AI Slim 2.71 | OpenAI Agents SDK 0.25 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Streaming, sequential + parallel tool calls on DeepSeek | yes | yes (set sequential tools, `strict` off) | yes |
| Cancel → upstream TCP closed (median) | 0.1 ms (`aclose`) | 1.6–1.8 ms fake server, 0.6 ms DeepSeek | 0.4 ms |
| New LLM requests / tools after cancel | 0 (no Stop path yet) | 0 | 0 |
| Waits for started sync work on cancel | our `Threads.drain` | no, keep `Threads` | no, keep `Threads` |
| ReplyGuard before text is streamed | yes | yes (`iter` + `node.stream`) | yes |
| Budgets (steps, tools per step / turn, token soft cap) | ours | timeout and per-call output built in; rest via our `budget.py` | steps and timeout built in; rest via hooks |
| Tracing | none | OpenTelemetry native; **no outbound export by default** | own span model; **remote export to OpenAI on by default**, must be replaced |
| Runtime deps (packages) | 22–23 | +16 | +23 |
| Install / image delta | — | +39 MB unpacked, +7 MB compressed | about +56 MB |
| Cold import | 0.10–0.17 s | +0.32 s | +0.45 s |
| `backend/app/agent` net LOC | 2237 | about −120 (−5%) | about −100 (−5%) |
| Real-model cost of the POC | — | about $0.03 | $0.0046 |

That fits #35 directly. The dependency cost is the smaller of the two SDKs.

Neither SDK met the plan's "clearly less code to maintain" rule: each removes about 5% net. The owner chose
adoption anyway, for standard cancellation and tracing semantics that a widely used runtime maintains. Without the
SDK, the same features would be hand-written and maintained here. The recommended alternative, keeping the own loop,
was considered and rejected on these grounds.

1	"""The agent loop (design §4): one chat turn as a stream of contract SSE events.
2	
3	    user message stored -> [LLM -> tools -> cards]* -> guarded text -> assistant message stored
4	
5	The LLM chooses tools and writes text; routes, prices and tickets come from the airline through
6	the four tools. Text is released sentence by sentence after the ReplyGuard traced every number
7	and city in it; the first problem replaces the whole reply with a code template. The turn's
8	quote cards become bookable only when `Airline.post_assistant_message` stores them (`done`).
9	
10	Runtime (ADR-001): Pydantic AI runs the model stream and dispatches the tool calls
11	(`Agent.iter` + `node.stream`); this module decides everything else - budgets, retries and their
12	charges, the guard, cards, app.db records, time limits, cancellation and the worker-thread drain.
13	
14	Nothing here can book: the loop talks to the airline through `Toolbox` (four tools, no booking)
15	and `post_assistant_message`. Booking is the HTTP endpoint's call, caused by the user's click.
16	"""
17	from __future__ import annotations
18	
19	import asyncio
20	import json
21	import logging
22	import secrets
23	import time
24	from collections import OrderedDict
25	from contextlib import contextmanager
26	from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace
27	from typing import Any, AsyncIterator, Awaitable, Callable, Iterator

30	from pydantic_ai import InstrumentationSettings, RunContext, Tool, UsageLimits

32	from pydantic_ai.exceptions import ModelAPIError, UnexpectedModelBehavior
33	from pydantic_ai.messages import (FunctionToolResultEvent, PartDeltaEvent, PartStartEvent,
34	                                  TextPart, TextPartDelta, ThinkingPart, ThinkingPartDelta, ToolCallPart,
35	                                  ToolCallPartDelta)
36

39	from .concurrency import ServerBusy, Threads, TurnConcurrency, TurnSlots

42	from .guard import CityIndex, ReplyGuard, SentenceBuffer
43	from .model import ChatModel, Completion, LLMError, ThinkSplitter, before_response, llm_error, to_model_messages
44	from .prompt import system_prompt
45	from .templates import CLICK_TO_BOOK, fallback_reply
46	from .tools import DEFAULT_STATUS, STATUS_TEXT, TOOL_SCHEMAS, MAX_RAW_ARGUMENTS, Outcome, Toolbox
47	
48	log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

50	DEFAULT_BUDGET = AgentBudget()
51	MAX_STEPS = DEFAULT_BUDGET.max_steps
52	TURN_TIMEOUT = DEFAULT_BUDGET.max_turn_seconds  # a whole turn (all LLM calls, tools, retries); then the template reply
53	LOCK_TIMEOUT = 10.0  # waiting for another turn of the same conversation; then conversation_busy
54	DRAIN_TIMEOUT = 30.0  # after the turn's time limit: waiting for its worker threads (design §4.9)
55	MAX_USER_CHARS = 2000
56	TITLE_CHARS = 60
57	LLM_UNAVAILABLE = "The assistant is temporarily unavailable. Your message was saved; please try again."
58	BUSY = "This conversation is still working on your previous message. Please try again in a moment."
59	SERVER_BUSY = "The assistant is busy right now. Your message was not sent; please try again in a moment."
60	INTERNAL = "Something went wrong. Your message was saved; please try again."
61	NOT_STORED = "Something went wrong and your message was not saved. Please try again in a moment."
62	USER_BUSY = ("Your other conversations are still working on earlier messages. "
63	             "Please wait for a reply there, then try again.")
64	FINISHED_RUNS_KEPT = 1024  # finished runs the cancel endpoint still knows (repeated Stop, late Stop)
65	CANCELLED_CALL = {"code": "cancelled", "message": "The user stopped the reply before this tool call finished."}
66	TERMINAL = {"done": "completed", "cancelled": "cancelled", "error": "failed"}  # event -> final run state
67	FLOOD_FACTOR = 4  # a completion with more than max_tool_calls_per_step * this many calls runs none
68	SDK_TOOL_RETRIES = 1000  # the SDK's own per-tool retry cap; our budget ends a turn long before
69	_RAW = "__raw__"  # arguments the SDK could not parse, handed to Toolbox.run as the raw string

74	    """One SSE event of docs/api/contract.md: `name` and its JSON `data`."""
75	
76	    name: str

107	
108	    `state`: queued (waiting for the conversation lock / a slot; nothing stored yet) -> running
109	    (from the moment the user message is being stored) -> finishing (the steps ended; the reply

272	    def stream_turn(self, user_id: str, conversation_id: str, text: str, *,
273	                    reasoning_effort: str | None = None,
274	                    on_not_stored: Callable[[], Any] | None = None,
275	                    on_server_busy: Callable[[], Any] | None = None,
276	                    owner_checked: bool = False) -> TurnStream:
277	        """Start a turn and return its events: `user_message`, then `status` / `card` / `delta` /
278	        `replace` / `ping`, ending with exactly one `done`, `cancelled` (Stop, `cancel_run`) or
279	        `error`. The first event other than `ping` carries the run's `run_id` (also
280	        `TurnStream.run_id`).
281	
282	        `reasoning_effort` overrides the LLM's thinking level for this turn (none / low / high /
283	        max; None = configured default). `on_not_stored`: a blocking callable run (in a worker
284	        thread, before the event is sent) when the turn ends before the user's message was
285	        stored: refused with `server_busy`, or app.db failed to store the message
286	        (`internal_error`) - the API gives the day's message slot back there. It runs even when
287	        nobody reads the stream. `on_server_busy` is its older name.
288	        `owner_checked`: the caller already checked (off the event loop) that the conversation is
289	        the user's, so this method reads nothing from app.db (06 review P2-9); the turn's own
290	        writes still check ownership.
291	
292	        Raises before anything is stored: NotFound (not the user's conversation), ValueError
293	        (empty or too long text, unknown reasoning_effort). Must be called on the event loop. The turn runs in its own
294	        task: it finishes and is stored even when the client stops reading."""
295	        if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():
296	            raise ValueError("text must not be empty")
297	        text = text.strip()
298	        if len(text) > MAX_USER_CHARS:
299	            raise ValueError(f"text is longer than {MAX_USER_CHARS} characters")
300	        if reasoning_effort is not None and reasoning_effort not in EFFORTS:
301	            raise ValueError(f"reasoning_effort must be one of {', '.join(EFFORTS)}")
302	        if not owner_checked and self.store.get_conversation(user_id, conversation_id) is None:

305	        run = Run(f"r_{secrets.token_hex(8)}", user_id, conversation_id)
306	        self._runs[run.id] = run
307	        run.task = task = asyncio.get_running_loop().create_task(
308	            self._run(run, text, reasoning_effort, queue, on_not_stored or on_server_busy))
309	        self._tasks.add(task)
310	        task.add_done_callback(self._tasks.discard)

313	    def cancel_run(self, user_id: str, conversation_id: str, run_id: str) -> str | None:
314	        """The user's Stop (#48): cancel the run `run_id` of the user's conversation. Returns the
315	        run's state after the request (`cancelling` when this Stop was accepted; `cancelled` for a
316	        repeated Stop; `finishing` / `completed` / `failed` when it came too late and changes
317	        nothing), or None when no such run of this user and conversation is known (R1).
318	
319	        Queued (nothing stored yet): the run's task is cancelled; nothing is stored and the day's
320	        message slot is given back (R5). Running: no further LLM request or tool call starts and
321	        the model's HTTP stream is closed (R2); a worker thread that already started runs to its
322	        end and is drained before the stopped reply is stored and the lock and slot are released
323	        (R3). Only this method stops a run: a client that stops reading does not. Event loop only."""
324	        run = self._runs.get(run_id) or self._finished.get(run_id)
325	        if run is None or run.user_id != user_id or run.conversation_id != conversation_id:
326	            return None
327	        if run.state not in ("queued", "running"):
328	            return run.state  # cancelling, finishing or ended: idempotent, nothing changes (R8)
329	        turn = run.turn
330	        if turn is not None and turn.steps_task is not None and turn.steps_task.done():
331	            # the steps ended in this instant (their result is set, `_turn` has not resumed yet):
332	            # the reply counts as complete and is stored as usual (R4; test_p2_9_…finishing…)
333	            return "finishing"
334	        queued = run.state == "queued"
335	        run.state = "cancelling"
336	        run.stop_requested = time.monotonic()
337	        log.info("agent.run.stop_requested run=%s conversation=%s queued=%s", run.id, conversation_id, queued)
338	        if queued:
339	            if run.started and run.task is not None:
340	                run.task.cancel()  # waiting for the lock or a slot; `_run` settles it
341	        elif turn is not None:
342	            run.tokens_at_stop = turn.budget.tokens
343	            turn.cancelled = True
344	            if turn.steps_task is not None:
345	                turn.steps_task.cancel()
346	        # else: the user message is being stored or the context built; `_turn` sees the state
347	        return "cancelling"

349	    def cancel(self, user_id: str, conversation_id: str) -> bool:
350	        """Stop the user's running turn in `conversation_id` (any run id; tests and tools). True
351	        when a Stop was accepted. See `cancel_run`."""
352	        for run in list(self._runs.values()):
353	            if run.user_id == user_id and run.conversation_id == conversation_id \
354	                    and run.state in ("queued", "running"):
355	                return self.cancel_run(user_id, conversation_id, run.id) == "cancelling"
356	        return False

391	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ one turn -----------
392	    async def _run(self, run: Run, text: str, reasoning_effort: str | None,
393	                   queue: asyncio.Queue, on_not_stored: Callable[[], Any] | None = None) -> None:
394	        user_id, conversation_id = run.user_id, run.conversation_id
395	        run.started = True
396	
397	        def emit(name: str, data: dict) -> None:
398	            if run.terminal is not None:  # R4: nothing after the terminal event
399	                log.error("chat turn: %s after %s dropped (run %s)", name, run.terminal, run.id)
400	                return
401	            if not run.sent_first:
402	                data = {**data, "run_id": run.id}  # the first event carries the run id
403	                run.sent_first = True
404	            if name in TERMINAL:
405	                run.terminal = name
406	                run.state = TERMINAL[name]
407	            queue.put_nowait(Event(name, data))
408	
409	        async def not_stored() -> None:
410	            if on_not_stored is not None:
411	                try:
412	                    await asyncio.to_thread(on_not_stored)
413	                except Exception:
414	                    log.exception("not-stored callback failed (conversation %s)", conversation_id)
415	
416	        # The conversation lock first, then the user's own limit, then a server-wide slot: a
417	        # second message of a busy conversation waits without taking a slot. Every refusal comes
418	        # before anything is stored.
419	        try:
420	            if run.state == "cancelling":  # stopped before the task began
421	                raise asyncio.CancelledError()
422	            async with self._locks.hold_async(conversation_id, timeout=self.lock_timeout):
423	                with self._user_turn(user_id):
424	                    async with self.slots.hold():
425	                        await self._turn(run, text, reasoning_effort, emit)
426	        except asyncio.CancelledError:
427	            task = asyncio.current_task()
428	            if run.state != "cancelling" or run.turn is not None or (task is not None and task.uncancel() > 0):
429	                raise  # shutdown, not a Stop
430	            # Stop while queued (R5): nothing was stored; the day's message slot is given back
431	            await not_stored()
432	            emit("cancelled", {"run_id": run.id, "message": None})
433	            self._log_stopped(run, None)
434	        except ConversationBusy:
435	            emit("error", {"code": "conversation_busy", "message": BUSY})
436	        except _UserBusy:
437	            log.warning("chat turn refused: user already has %d turns running (conversation %s)",
438	                        self.slots.config.max_turns_per_user, conversation_id)
439	            emit("error", {"code": "conversation_busy", "message": USER_BUSY})
440	        except ServerBusy:
441	            run.state = "finishing"  # refused: a Stop from here on is too late (review P2-1)
442	            log.warning("chat turn refused: %d turns running, none ended within %gs (conversation %s)",
443	                        self.slots.active, self.slots.config.queue_seconds, conversation_id)
444	            await not_stored()
445	            emit("error", {"code": "server_busy", "message": SERVER_BUSY})
446	        except _NotStored:
447	            run.state = "finishing"  # (review P2-1)
448	            log.exception("chat turn: the user's message could not be stored (conversation %s)", conversation_id)
449	            await not_stored()
450	            emit("error", {"code": "internal_error", "message": NOT_STORED})
451	        except Exception:
452	            log.exception("chat turn failed (conversation %s)", conversation_id)
453	            emit("error", {"code": "internal_error", "message": INTERNAL})
454	        finally:
455	            if run.terminal is None:
456	                # R4 backstop (review P2-1): every stream ends with a terminal event, also when the
457	                # task was cancelled by a shutdown or a path above ended without one
458	                emit("error", {"code": "internal_error", "message": INTERNAL})
459	            self._retire(run)
460	            queue.put_nowait(None)

470	    @contextmanager
471	    def _user_turn(self, user_id: str) -> Iterator[None]:
472	        """At most `max_turns_per_user` running turns per user (06 review P2-8). Event loop only."""
473	        if self._user_turns.get(user_id, 0) >= self.slots.config.max_turns_per_user:
474	            raise _UserBusy()
475	        self._user_turns[user_id] = self._user_turns.get(user_id, 0) + 1
476	        try:
477	            yield
478	        finally:
479	            self._user_turns[user_id] -= 1
480	            if not self._user_turns[user_id]:
481	                del self._user_turns[user_id]

483	    async def _turn(self, run: Run, text: str, reasoning_effort: str | None,
484	                    emit: Callable[[str, dict], None]) -> None:
485	        user_id, conversation_id = run.user_id, run.conversation_id
486	        store = self.store
487	        conversation = await asyncio.to_thread(store.get_conversation, user_id, conversation_id)
488	        # From here a Stop no longer cancels this task: the user message may be stored (R5)
489	        run.state = "running"
490	        try:
491	            user_message = await asyncio.to_thread(store.add_message, user_id, conversation_id, "user", text)
492	        except Exception as exc:  # app.db timeout, the conversation gone: nothing of the turn exists
493	            raise _NotStored() from exc
494	        emit("user_message", message_view(user_message))
495	        if conversation is not None and not conversation["title"]:
496	            await asyncio.to_thread(store.set_conversation_title, user_id, conversation_id,
497	                                    " ".join(text.split())[:TITLE_CHARS])
498	
499	        context = await asyncio.to_thread(build_context, store, user_id, conversation_id)
500	        index = await asyncio.to_thread(self._city_index)
501	        today = store.clock().date()
502	        guard = ReplyGuard(index, records=context.records, user_text=text,
503	                           earlier_user_texts=context.user_texts[:-1], today=today)
504	        turn = _Turn(user_id, conversation_id, user_message, guard, emit, BudgetTracker(self.budget),
505	                     reasoning_effort)
506	        turn.messages = messages = [{"role": "system", "content": system_prompt(today)}, *context.messages]
507	        run.turn = turn
508	        if run.state == "cancelling":  # stopped while the message was stored: no step starts
509	            turn.cancelled = True
510	            run.tokens_at_stop = 0
511	
512	        self._running[conversation_id] = turn
513	        stopped = False
514	        drain_ms = None
515	        try:
516	            try:
517	                try:
518	                    if not turn.cancelled:
519	                        async with asyncio.timeout(self.turn_timeout):
520	                            turn.steps_task = asyncio.ensure_future(self._steps(turn, messages))
521	                            fallback = await turn.steps_task
522	                        run.state = "finishing"
523	                    else:
524	                        stopped = True
525	                finally:
526	                    drain_started = time.monotonic()
527	                    await self._drain(turn)
528	                    drain_ms = int((time.monotonic() - drain_started) * 1000)
529	            except asyncio.CancelledError:
530	                task = asyncio.current_task()
531	                if not turn.cancelled or (task is not None and task.cancelling()):
532	                    raise  # shutdown, not a Stop
533	                stopped = True
534	            except TimeoutError:
535	                fallback = [{"kind": "turn_timeout", "value": str(self.turn_timeout)}]
536	            except LLMError as exc:
537	                fallback = [{"kind": "llm_error", "value": str(exc)[:200]}]
538	            except Exception as exc:  # a bug or a store error in the middle of the turn
539	                if not turn.outcomes and not turn.text:
540	                    raise
541	                log.exception("chat turn failed after producing output (conversation %s)", conversation_id)
542	                fallback = [{"kind": "internal_error", "value": type(exc).__name__}]
543	        finally:
544	            if self._running.get(conversation_id) is turn:
545	                del self._running[conversation_id]
546	        # an accepted Stop always ends `cancelled` (R4), also when the steps ended anyway in the
547	        # same instant (or a library swallowed the cancellation)
548	        stopped = stopped or turn.cancelled
549	        if stopped:
550	            await self._finish_stopped(run, turn)
551	            self._log_stopped(run, turn, drain_ms)
552	            return
553	        run.state = "finishing"
554	        if fallback is not None and fallback[0]["kind"] in ("max_steps", "token_budget", "tool_budget"):
555	            log.warning("chat turn stopped by its budget (conversation %s): %s %s", conversation_id,
556	                        fallback[0]["kind"], turn.budget.snapshot())
557	        if fallback is not None and fallback[0]["kind"] in ("llm_error", "turn_timeout") \
558	                and not turn.outcomes and not turn.text:
559	            emit("error", {"code": "llm_unavailable", "message": LLM_UNAVAILABLE})
560	            return

563	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ the steps ----------
564	    async def _steps(self, turn: _Turn, messages: list[dict]) -> list[dict] | None:
565	        """The LLM / tool steps of a turn. Returns None when the LLM's text can stay, otherwise
566	        the problems that make the template reply replace it.
567	
568	        One Pydantic AI run drives the steps: it streams each LLM call and dispatches its tool
569	        calls (one at a time, in call order, see `_sdk_tools`). `messages` is our copy of the
570	        context in the OpenAI shape (estimates, llm_calls records); a failed LLM call that is
571	        retried restarts the run from it.
572	
573	        Budgets (design §4.8): a step starts only while steps and tokens are left; each tool call
574	        runs only while calls are left for the step and the turn. A call that is not admitted is
575	        never executed: it gets a `tool_budget_exceeded` result (stored like any tool call, so
576	        every tool call of the completion has its result and the stored history stays well-formed).
577	        Once the turn's calls are used up and a call was refused, the turn ends with the template."""
578	        while True:
579	            try:
580	                return await self._run_steps(turn, messages)
581	            except _RetryStep:  # the step's retry count is on the turn (`turn.attempt`)
582	                pass
583	
584	    async def _run_steps(self, turn: _Turn, messages: list[dict]) -> list[dict] | None:
585	        settings = self.llm.settings(turn.reasoning_effort)
586	        # no SDK request limit: the steps budget (max 20 by env bounds) is the only one
587	        async with self._runtime.iter(None, message_history=to_model_messages(messages), deps=turn,
588	                                      model_settings=settings, usage_limits=UsageLimits(request_limit=None)) as run:
589	            async for node in run:
590	                if _Runtime.is_model_request_node(node):
591	                    if turn.cancelled:  # R2: no LLM request after a Stop
592	                        raise asyncio.CancelledError()
593	                    if turn.attempt == 0 and (stop := turn.budget.stop_before_step()) is not None:
594	                        return [stop]  # (a retry belongs to the step already counted)
595	                    try:
596	                        completion = await self._llm_step(turn, messages, run, node)
597	                    except _Stopped as stopped:  # guard failure, or no retry left within the token cap
598	                        return stopped.problems
599	                    if not completion.tool_calls:
600	                        if completion.finish_reason != "stop":  # "length", "content_filter", ...
601	                            return [{"kind": "truncated", "value": str(completion.finish_reason)}]
602	                        if not turn.text.strip():
603	                            return [{"kind": "empty_reply", "value": ""}]
604	                        return None
605	                    if _flooded(completion, self.budget):
606	                        # far more calls than a step may run (06 review P2-3): none runs and none is
607	                        # stored one by one; the logged completion is marked so the next context skips it
608	                        refused = len(completion.tool_calls)
609	                        turn.budget.refused_calls += refused
610	                        log.warning("chat turn: a completion with %d tool calls; none run (conversation %s)",
611	                                    refused, turn.conversation_id)
612	                        return [{"kind": "tool_budget", "value": str(refused)}]
613	                    messages.append(completion.assistant_message())
614	                    turn.step_calls, turn.step_results, turn.step_logged = completion.tool_calls, {}, 0
615	                elif _Runtime.is_call_tools_node(node):
616	                    async with node.stream(run.ctx) as events:
617	                        async for event in events:
618	                            if isinstance(event, FunctionToolResultEvent) \
619	                                    and event.part.tool_call_id not in turn.step_results:

621	                                # tools, refused by the SDK before any tool ran. It is answered and
622	                                # stored as before (`unknown_tool`, from Toolbox.run)
623	                                await self._tool_call(turn, event.part.tool_call_id, event.part.tool_name or "")

627	                        messages.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": call["id"], "content": outcome.for_llm()})
628	                    if turn.exhausted:

631	        raise AssertionError("the run ended without a step that returned")

633	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ tools --------------
634	    def _sdk_tools(self) -> list[Tool]:
635	        """The four tools as SDK tools over our own schemas and `Toolbox` (validation, structured
636	        errors). Sequential: one call at a time, in the order the model made them, so the budget
637	        admits them in order and the cards keep that order. `strict` off: the request carries the
638	        schemas exactly as before."""
639	        def body(name: str) -> Callable[..., Awaitable[str]]:
640	            async def run(ctx: RunContext[_Turn], **_args: Any) -> str:
641	                # the arguments the model sent are taken raw from the completion in `_tool_call`
642	                return (await self._tool_call(ctx.deps, ctx.tool_call_id or "", name)).for_llm()
643	            return run
644	
645	        tools = []
646	        for schema in TOOL_SCHEMAS:
647	            name = schema["function"]["name"]
648	            tool = Tool.from_schema(body(name), name=name, description=schema["function"]["description"],
649	                                    json_schema=schema["function"]["parameters"], takes_ctx=True, sequential=True)
650	            tool.strict = False
651	            tools.append(tool)
652	        return tools
653	
654	    async def _tool_call(self, turn: _Turn, call_id: str, name: str) -> Outcome:
655	        """Admit, run and record one tool call of the current step. The arguments are the model's
656	        raw string (from the completion), validated by `Toolbox.run`. The blocking work runs in a
657	        tracked worker thread: if the turn is cancelled meanwhile the thread still ends, and the
658	        turn waits for it (`_drain`) before it releases its lock."""
659	        call = next((c for c in turn.step_calls if c["id"] == call_id),
660	                    {"id": call_id, "name": name, "arguments": ""})
661	        if turn.cancelled:  # R2: never start a tool after a Stop (also if the SDK caught the cancel)
662	            raise asyncio.CancelledError()
663	        refused = turn.budget.admit_tool_call()
664	        if refused is None:
665	            turn.emit("status", {"text": STATUS_TEXT.get(call["name"], DEFAULT_STATUS)})
666	            turn.in_flight = call_id
667	            outcome = await turn.threads.run(self._tools.run, turn.user_id, turn.conversation_id,
668	                                             call["name"], call["arguments"])
669	            if turn.cancelled:  # the Stop came while the thread ran: its result is not used (R7)
670	                raise asyncio.CancelledError()  # (in_flight still names it: stored as interrupted)
671	            turn.in_flight = None
672	        else:
673	            turn.exhausted = turn.exhausted or refused == "per_turn"
674	            payload = refusal(refused, self.budget)
675	            outcome = Outcome(call["name"], str(call["arguments"])[:MAX_RAW_ARGUMENTS], payload["code"], payload,
676	                              error=f"budget: {refused}")
677	        # The outcome and its cards belong to the turn as soon as the tool returned, before
678	        # the row is written: if the time limit lands on the write, the reply still
679	        # carries the card that the stored row (written while draining) describes (P2-5).
680	        turn.outcomes.append(outcome)
681	        if refused is None:  # a refusal is no record a reply may quote
682	            turn.guard.add_record(outcome.payload)
683	        for card in outcome.cards:
684	            turn.cards.append(card)
685	            turn.emit("card", {"card": card})
686	        turn.step_results[call_id] = outcome
687	        await self._log_tool_calls(turn)
688	        return outcome
689	
690	    async def _log_tool_calls(self, turn: _Turn, *, final: bool = False) -> None:
691	        """Store the tool_calls rows of the step in call order (context.py lines them up with
692	        the completion), each as soon as it and every call before it have their outcome."""
693	        while turn.step_logged < len(turn.step_calls):
694	            outcome = turn.step_results.get(turn.step_calls[turn.step_logged]["id"])
695	            if outcome is None:
696	                if not final:
697	                    return
698	                raise RuntimeError("a tool call of the step got no result")
699	            turn.step_logged += 1
700	            await turn.threads.run(
701	                self.store.add_tool_call, turn.user_id, turn.user_message["id"], outcome.name,
702	                outcome.args, outcome.payload, error=outcome.error, latency_ms=outcome.latency_ms)
703	
704	    async def _drain(self, turn: _Turn) -> None:
705	        """Wait for worker threads the time limit (or an error) left running. A thread cannot be
706	        stopped; until it ends it may still write (a quote, a tool call row), so the reply is not
707	        stored and the conversation lock and the slot are not released before it ends - unless it
708	        outlives `drain_timeout` (store timeouts make that unlikely), which is logged."""
709	        if not turn.threads.running:
710	            return
711	        log.warning("chat turn cut short with %d worker thread(s) running; waiting up to %gs (conversation %s)",
712	                    turn.threads.running, self.drain_timeout, turn.conversation_id)
713	        if not await turn.threads.drain(self.drain_timeout):
714	            log.error("chat turn: %d worker thread(s) still running after %gs; ending the turn anyway "
715	                      "(conversation %s)", turn.threads.running, self.drain_timeout, turn.conversation_id)

717	    async def _finish(self, turn: _Turn, fallback: list[dict] | None = None) -> None:
718	        """Persist the assistant message (the `done` moment: quote cards become bookable)."""
719	        text = turn.text.rstrip()
720	        if fallback is not None:
721	            text = fallback_reply(turn.outcomes)
722	            turn.emit("replace", {"text": text})
723	        elif CLICK_TO_BOOK not in text and any(
724	                o.name == "request_booking" and o.code == "ok" for o in turn.outcomes):

726	            piece = ("\n\n" if text else "") + CLICK_TO_BOOK

729	        message = await asyncio.to_thread(
730	            self._post_assistant_message, turn.user_id, turn.conversation_id, text, turn.cards, fallback)

732	
733	    async def _finish_stopped(self, run: Run, turn: _Turn) -> None:
734	        """Store a reply the user stopped (R5-R7), after its worker threads were drained: only the
735	        text already released through the guard (no template, no click hint) and the cards of

741	                started = call["id"] == turn.in_flight
742	                if started:

744	                             call["name"], run.id)

746	                    call["name"], str(call["arguments"])[:MAX_RAW_ARGUMENTS], "cancelled", dict(CANCELLED_CALL),
747	                    error="cancelled: interrupted" if started else "cancelled: not run")
748	        await self._log_tool_calls(turn, final=True)
749	        message = await asyncio.to_thread(
750	            self._post_assistant_message, turn.user_id, turn.conversation_id, turn.text.rstrip(), turn.cards,
751	            [{"kind": "cancelled", "value": ""}], present=False, status="cancelled")
752	        turn.emit("cancelled", {"run_id": run.id, "message": message})
753	
754	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ LLM step -----------
755	    def _release(self, turn: _Turn, piece: str, first_of_step: bool) -> None:
756	        """Check the reply so far plus `piece`; send `piece` when nothing is wrong. Checking the
757	        whole text catches a number or a city name that spans two pieces (`St. | Louis`)."""
758	        if not turn.text:
759	            piece = piece.lstrip()
760	        elif first_of_step and not turn.text[-1].isspace() and not piece[:1].isspace():
761	            piece = "\n\n" + piece  # text of a later step starts a new paragraph
762	        problems = turn.guard.check(turn.text + piece)
763	        if problems:
764	            raise _GuardFailed(problems)
765	        turn.text += piece
766	        turn.emit("delta", {"text": piece})

768	    async def _llm_step(self, turn: _Turn, messages: list[dict], run: Any, node: Any) -> Completion:
769	        """One LLM call (one attempt). Text is released as it streams. A failed call is logged
770	        and charged; it is retried (`_RetryStep`, after the backoff) only while none of its text
771	        has been released, retries are left for this step (`turn.attempt`, reset when a call
772	        succeeds) and the turn still has tokens."""
773	        attempt = turn.attempt
774	        request = {"turn": turn.user_message["id"], "messages": list(messages),

776	                   "reasoning_effort": self.llm.effort(turn.reasoning_effort)}

778	        buffer = SentenceBuffer()
779	        think = ThinkSplitter()  # an inline <think> block (servers without reasoning_content)
780	        thought = ""
781	        released = False
782	        content = blank = ""
783	        received: int | None = None  # output characters, once any output arrived

785	        def log_call(response: dict, usage: Any = None, *, output_chars: int | None = None,

795	                self.store.add_llm_call, turn.user_id, turn.conversation_id, request, response,
796	                latency_ms=int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000), tokens=charged,
797	                model=getattr(self.llm, "model", None))

799	        def got(n: int) -> None:
800	            # output seen so far, for a call that fails part-way; a complete call is charged from
801	            # its final response instead (`Completion.output_chars`, the same count)
802	            nonlocal received
803	            received = (received or 0) + n
804	
805	        def show(text: str) -> None:
806	            """Visible text: released sentence by sentence through the guard."""
807	            nonlocal content, blank, released
808	            content += text
809	            for sentence in buffer.push(text):
810	                if sentence.strip():
811	                    self._release(turn, blank + sentence, not released)
812	                    blank, released = "", True
813	                else:
814	                    blank += sentence  # white space is never sent on its own
815	
816	        try:
817	            # the per-call time limit; leaving the block (a guard failure, the limit, a
818	            # cancellation) closes the model's HTTP stream (on a real connection: at once)
819	            async with asyncio.timeout(self.llm_timeout):
820	                async with node.stream(run.ctx) as stream:
821	                    async for event in stream:
822	                        text = ""
823	                        if isinstance(event, PartStartEvent):
824	                            part = event.part
825	                            if isinstance(part, TextPart):
826	                                text = part.content
827	                            elif isinstance(part, ThinkingPart):
828	                                got(len(part.content))
829	                            elif isinstance(part, ToolCallPart):
830	                                got(len(part.tool_name) + len(part.args_as_json_str() if part.args else ""))
831	                        elif isinstance(event, PartDeltaEvent):
832	                            delta = event.delta
833	                            if isinstance(delta, TextPartDelta):
834	                                text = delta.content_delta
835	                            elif isinstance(delta, ThinkingPartDelta):
836	                                got(len(delta.content_delta or ""))
837	                            elif isinstance(delta, ToolCallPartDelta):
838	                                args = delta.args_delta
839	                                got(len(delta.tool_name_delta or "")
840	                                    + len(args if isinstance(args, str) else json.dumps(args or {})))
841	                        if not text:
842	                            continue
843	                        got(len(text))
844	                        text, inline = think.feed(text)
845	                        thought += inline
846	                        show(text)
847	                    response = stream.response
848	                _unique_call_ids(response)
849	                text, inline = think.finish()
850	                thought += inline
851	                show(text)
852	                completion = Completion.from_response(response, content)
853	                completion.reasoning += thought
854	                if completion.finish_reason is None:  # the stream ended early (no finish reason)
855	                    raise LLMError("LLM stream ended without a finish_reason", retryable=True,
856	                                   received=completion.output_chars, usage=completion.usage)
857	                rest = buffer.flush()
858	                if rest.strip():
859	                    self._release(turn, blank + rest, not released)
860	        except _GuardFailed as failed:
861	            # the stream was cut by us; how much (hidden) output it produced is unknown
862	            await asyncio.shield(log_call({"content": content, "guard_problems": failed.problems,
863	                                           "aborted": True}))
864	            raise
865	        except asyncio.CancelledError:
866	            # the turn's time limit, a cancellation or shutdown interrupted this call: it is still
867	            # recorded and charged (06 review P2-4); `_drain` waits for the record to be written
868	            log_call({"content": content, "aborted": "cancelled" if turn.cancelled else "turn_timeout"})
869	            raise
870	        except Exception as exc:  # every other failure of the call is a failed, logged, charged call (review P2-2)
871	            if isinstance(exc, TimeoutError):  # this call's own time limit: output unknown
872	                error, usage, received = LLMError("LLM call timed out", retryable=True), None, None
873	            else:
874	                if not isinstance(exc, (LLMError, ModelAPIError, UnexpectedModelBehavior)):

876	                    # here): retried like a broken stream, with the original kept in the log
877	                    log.warning("LLM call failed with %s (conversation %s)", type(exc).__name__,

879	                if received is None and not before_response(exc):
880	                    received = 0  # a response body was read, with no output in it (e.g. not SSE)

896	        if _flooded(completion, self.budget):
897	            record["tool_calls_not_run"] = True  # build_context skips this completion

899	            # the step's calls are known before the completion is logged: a Stop during the write
900	            # still stores a (cancelled) row for each of them (R7)
901	            turn.step_calls, turn.step_results, turn.step_logged = completion.tool_calls, {}, 0
902	        await asyncio.shield(log_call(record, completion.usage, output_chars=completion.output_chars))

904

906	        """City names for the guard, from the airline's current network (rebuilt when

908	        net = self._networks.current()

914	def _unique_call_ids(response: Any) -> None:
915	    """Some OpenAI-compatible servers repeat a tool_call_id within one completion (`call_0` twice);
916	    the SDK refuses such a response. Repeats get a suffix (`call_0~2`), in place, so the step runs
917	    as it did before ADR-001 (review P2-1). The ids are ours to choose: they only pair a call with
918	    its result."""
919	    seen: set[str] = set()
920	    for part in response.parts:
921	        if isinstance(part, ToolCallPart) and part.tool_call_id:
922	            call_id, n = part.tool_call_id, 1
923	            while call_id in seen:
924	                n += 1
925	                call_id = f"{part.tool_call_id}~{n}"
926	            part.tool_call_id = call_id
927	            seen.add(call_id)
928

930	def _flooded(completion: Completion, budget: AgentBudget) -> bool:
931	    """More tool calls in one completion than any honest step needs (P2-3)."""
932	    return len(completion.tool_calls) > budget.max_tool_calls_per_step * FLOOD_FACTOR
